host_adaptations: Shell bootstrap removes the pre-existing system python3 requirement and uses Bash plus the managed Node runtime.
Python installation disables user-bin and Windows registry writes and keeps the uv cache under runtime_root.
Runtime reuse validates the exact manifest identity and contained executable before rebuilding only an invalid versioned directory.
The PowerShell asset includes a UTF-8 BOM so Windows PowerShell 5.1 can parse bilingual comments.
